core.title: Philtower Lever with Woodward Rose, Weslock 3705
tags: Contemporary Urbana Lever With Woodward Roses

text.description_html:
Weslock 3705, Philtower Leverset with Woodward Rose

The Philtower contemporary door lever features a rectangular rose and tapered lever handle. This door lever is not only contemporary but its unique shape is ultra sleek making it an excellent choice for those who like a more minimalistic look. Available in your choice of oil rubbed bronze or satin nickel finish. The Contemporary Philtower Lever With Woodward Rose is adjustable to fit door thicknesses from 1-3/8 inches to 1-3/4 inches. The backset is also adjustable for either 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches with a removable faceplate.

Also available: Impresa Knob With Woodward Rose

This modern styled lever is from the Weslock Elegance Collection which features lifetime finish and mechanical warranties.

Features of the Contemporary Philtower Lever With Woodward Rose:

  • Rose and lever material: Zinc Diecast
  • Adjustable latches include removable faceplates.
  • Removable door lever prevents scratching during installation.
  • Panic-proof privacy function - one turn of interior lever unlocks and opens door.
  • Push-button locking rosette.
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Limited 10 Year Finish Warranty
  • Fully ADA Compliant

Specifications of the Weslock Contemporary Philtower Lever with Rectangular Rose:

  • Lever Projection: 2-5/8"
  • Rose Style: Rectangular
  • Rose Height: 5"
  • Rose Width: 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable from 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: adjustable for either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplate
  • Fits doors prepared with 2-1/8" cross hole and 1" edge hole

When Selecting a Function:

  • Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim. Does not latch and does not lock.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latches but does not lock. Door lever operates latch from either side of door.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking for privacy. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior rose engages privacy lock; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Turning inside lever will release privacy and retract latchbolt.

Sold Individually
